viewing_check: Photograph the label on the underside or rear of each unit for model number (Sub: S1/S2 plus Gen, Play:5 Gen 2 = model S2 / A100 vs Gen 1 = S1 older), and ask if either can be powered on and show the white pulsing light. Check Sub for cabinet cracks or fraying, and that the Play:5 grille and top touch controls are intact. Confirm both power leads are Sonos.
